hero.headline: Trauma-Informed Care
hero.subhead: Safety-first processing. We recognize the impact of past trauma on addiction. Our clinicians use specialized protocols to process these experiences and reduce hyper-vigilance without causing re-traumatization.

image.alt: A calm meditation room at Des Moines Wellness Center used for trauma-informed work

sections.heading: What trauma-informed care involves
body: Trauma-informed care is less a single therapy than a way of running the whole programme. It starts from the assumption that a significant number of people entering treatment have a trauma history, and that treatment itself can do harm if it ignores that.

In practice it changes pace and sequencing. Safety and stabilization come before any processing of difficult material, you are not pushed to disclose before you are ready, and clinicians watch for signs that a session is moving faster than is useful. Substance use is understood partly as an attempt to manage symptoms — hyper-vigilance, intrusive memories, sleeplessness — rather than as a failure of will.

items.title: Stabilization before processing
items.text: Nothing difficult is opened up until you are physically and emotionally steady enough for it.

items.title: You set the pace
items.text: Disclosure is never a requirement of participation. Sessions move at a speed you control.

items.title: Applied across the programme
items.text: It informs how every clinician works, not just what happens in one specialist session.

sections.heading: Where it fits in your care
sections.subheading: Available at these levels of care. Most people move through more than one.

items.title: Medical Detox
items.text: A calm, low-stimulation environment during the most physically difficult stage.

items.title: Residential Inpatient
items.text: Trauma-aware pacing across the full residential schedule.

items.title: Partial Hospitalization (PHP)
items.text: Continued processing work with daily clinical support available.

items.title: Dual Diagnosis
items.text: Coordinated with treatment for PTSD and other co-occurring conditions.

items.title: Aftercare & Alumni
items.text: Ongoing support as trauma work continues beyond formal treatment.

sections.heading: Speak with our clinical team
body: Our intake specialists are available 24/7 for a confidential assessment. We can talk through which therapies fit your situation and verify your insurance on the same call.
